mapper.select: SELECT night_start, night_end, rate_extended, rate_night, rate_holiday, rate_holiday_over, rate_public_holiday, rate_labor_day, holiday_over_hours, weekly_limit_hours, daily_standard_hours, notice_threshold_minutes, updated_by FROM overtime_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE overtime_settings SET night_start = #{nightStart}, night_end = #{nightEnd}, rate_extended = #{rateExtended}, rate_night = #{rateNight}, rate_holiday = #{rateHoliday}, rate_holiday_over = #{rateHolidayOver}, rate_public_holiday = #{ratePublicHoliday}, rate_labor_day = #{rateLaborDay}, holiday_over_hours = #{holidayOverHours}, weekly_limit_hours = #{weeklyLimitHours}, daily_standard_hours = #{dailyStandardHours}, notice_threshold_minutes = #{noticeThresholdMinutes}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT group_code, extended_after_minutes, inclusive_monthly_minutes, TRUE AS configured FROM overtime_group_rules
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO overtime_group_rules(group_code, extended_after_minutes, inclusive_monthly_minutes) VALUES(#{groupCode}, #{extendedAfterMinutes}, #{inclusiveMonthlyMinutes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE extended_after_minutes = VALUES(extended_after_minutes), inclusive_monthly_minutes = VALUES(inclusive_monthly_minutes)
mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, u.name AS member_name, u.team_id, t.name AS team_name, r.work_date, r.start_at, r.end_at, r.break_minutes, r.request_kind, r.day_type, r.total_minutes, r.night_minutes, r.reason, r.status, r.current_approval_step, r.decided_by, r.rejected_reason, r.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO overtime_requests(user_id, work_date, start_at, end_at, break_minutes, request_kind, day_type, total_minutes, night_minutes, reason, status, current_approval_step) VALUES(#{userId}, #{workDate}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{breakMinutes}, #{requestKind}, #{dayType}, #{totalMinutes}, #{nightMinutes}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{currentApprovalStep})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM overtime_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM overtime_requests r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') AND (#{excludeId} IS NULL OR r.id != #{excludeId}) AND r.start_at < #{endAt} AND r.end_at > #{startAt} ORDER BY r.start_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE overtime_requests SET current_approval_step = #{step} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO overtime_sessions(user_id, work_date, check_in_at, check_out_at, source) VALUES(#{userId}, #{workDate}, #{checkInAt}, #{checkOutAt}, #{source})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, work_date, check_in_at, check_out_at, source FROM overtime_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND check_out_at IS NULL AND check_in_at >= #{since} ORDER BY check_in_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE overtime_sessions SET check_out_at = #{checkOutAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND check_out_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, work_date, check_in_at, check_out_at, source FROM overtime_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND work_date >= #{from} AND work_date <= #{to} ORDER BY check_in_at
